part.text: Brooklyn’s reported pedestrian injury counts are lower in 2025 than in 2013, but pedestrian deaths are higher. I’m checking three complementary count measures—injured pedestrians, pedestrian deaths, and crashes with any pedestrian casualty—using complete calendar years so the partial 2026 data don’t skew the comparison.

+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+sql = """
+SELECT
+  EXTRACT(year FROM crash_date)::INT AS year,
+  SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured)::BIGINT AS pedestrian_injuries,
+  SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths,
+  COUNT(*) FILTER (
+    WHERE number_of_pedestrians_injured > 0 OR number_of_pedestrians_killed > 0
+  )::BIGINT AS pedestrian_casualty_crashes
+FROM read_parquet(?)
+WHERE borough = ? AND crash_date >= ? AND crash_date < ?
+GROUP BY year
+ORDER BY year
+"""
+data = duckdb.sql(
+    sql,
+    params=["./data/crashes.parquet", "BROOKLYN", "2013-01-01", "2026-01-01"],
+).df()
+
+measures = [
+    (1, "pedestrian_injuries", "Pedestrians injured", "pedestrians injured", "#176B87"),
+    (2, "pedestrian_deaths", "Pedestrian deaths", "pedestrians killed", "#B43C39"),
+    (3, "pedestrian_casualty_crashes", "Crashes involving a pedestrian casualty", "crashes", "#4C7A43"),
+]
+
+plt.rcParams.update({
+    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
+    "axes.titlesize": 16,
+    "axes.titleweight": "bold",
+    "axes.labelsize": 11,
+})
+
+for option_id, column, title, ylabel, color in measures:
+    plotted = data[["year", column]].rename(columns={column: "value"})
+    plotted.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv", index=False)
+
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2), layout="constrained")
+    ax.plot(plotted["year"], plotted["value"], color=color, linewidth=2.8, marker="o", markersize=5)
+    ax.set_title(f"Brooklyn: {title}, 2013–2025", loc="left", pad=13)
+    ax.set_xlabel("Calendar year")
+    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel.capitalize())
+    ax.set_xticks(plotted["year"])
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#D9DEE2", linewidth=0.8)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines[["left", "bottom"]].set_color("#9AA4AA")
+    ax.annotate(f"{int(plotted.iloc[0]['value']):,}",
+                (plotted.iloc[0]["year"], plotted.iloc[0]["value"]),
+                xytext=(5, 9), textcoords="offset points", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
+    ax.annotate(f"{int(plotted.iloc[-1]['value']):,}",
+                (plotted.iloc[-1]["year"], plotted.iloc[-1]["value"]),
+                xytext=(-5, 9), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
+    fig.text(0.01, 0.005,
+             "Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes; Brooklyn; complete calendar years. Counts, not exposure-adjusted rates.",
+             fontsize=8, color="#4C565C")
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=180, facecolor="white")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+print(data.to_string(index=False))
+for _, column, *_ in measures:
+    start, end = int(data.iloc[0][column]), int(data.iloc[-1][column])
+    print(f"{column}: {start} -> {end}; change {end-start:+}; percent {(end/start-1)*100:+.1f}%")
*** End Patch
